query:
SELECT v.attendeeId as vSlot10Delegate, v.id as vSlot10MeetingId
FROM meetings v
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON v.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE s.companyName LIKE '%Veremark%' AND v.timeSlot = 10;
